faqs.title: Everything you need to know
faqs.subtitle: The answers to what we get asked most, so you know exactly how we work and what to expect before a project even starts.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: It depends on scope and complexity: a lean MVP starts at a few thousand euros, a multi-tenant product with AI and cloud integrations requires more investment. After a first call we give you a clear estimate, with no surprises along the way.

items.question: How long does it take to launch a project?
items.answer: An MVP is typically ready in 4-8 weeks. More complex projects, with multiple integrations or multi-tenant architectures, take longer — we give you a realistic timeline from the discovery phase.

items.question: What technologies do you use?
items.answer: Next.js and TypeScript for the web, React Native/Expo or native Swift for mobile, PostgreSQL for data, AWS for cloud infrastructure. We pick the stack based on the project, not the other way around.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We stay by your side for monitoring, maintenance and new features: the same team that built the product keeps supporting it after go-live.

items.question: Do I own the code?
items.answer: Always. The source code, infrastructure and every project asset are 100% yours, with no lock-in or dependency on us.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: With a no-commitment intro call to understand the project's goals and constraints. From there we propose a scope and estimate, and can kick off the discovery phase.

cta.title: Still have questions?
cta.text: Book a free, no-commitment call and we'll walk you through scope, timeline and budget.
